verdicts.rationale: 'Being and Time (1' is a truncation of 'Being and Time'; Heidegger, adjacent years (1961/1962) reflect edition/reprint of the same translation.
Olberg 1983, J. Comp. Physiol. A, vol 152, pp 297-307 identical; 'flip-flopping' vs 'flip-flop' is a trivial title variant of the same paper.

Narendra 2007 'Homing strategies... Melophorus bagoti' is a two-part series: Part I (pp 1798-1803, proportional path-integration) vs Part II (pp 1804-1812, interaction with visual cues). Different pages, different papers.
Cheung et al. series: 'general properties of directed walks' (2008, vol 99, 197-217) vs 'the difficulty of moving in a straight line' (2007, vol 97, 47-61). Different titles, years, volumes, pages.
'Which coordinate system for modelling path integration?' Vickerstaff & Cheung 2010, J. Theor. Biol. vol 263, pp 242-261 in both; b adds DOI/number. Same work.
'Die Axiome der Quantität und die Lehre vom Mass/Mas' (truncation), Hölder 1901, vol 53, pp 1-64 identical. Same article.
'The said and the unsaid', Horn 1992, Ohio State University Working Papers in Linguistics vol 40. Same work despite article/book type mismatch.
'gippocampus' is an OCR error for 'hippocampus'; identical title otherwise, Howard 2014, Curr. Biol. vol 24, pp 1331-1340. Same paper.
Carroll 'Theorizing the Moving Image' (1996, ISBN 9780521460491) vs 'Interpreting the Moving Image' (1998, ISBN 9780521589703) are two different books.
'Evolution in Four Dimensions', Jablonka & Lamb; a has full subtitle/series (2006 MIT reprint), b is short title (2005). Same book/work.

'From Metaphysics to Ethics' (Jackson, book, 2000) vs 'Precis of From Metaphysics to Ethics' (article, 2001, Philosophy and Phenomenological Research, DOI 10.2307/2653540). The précis is a separate published work.
'From Metaphysics to Ethics' (book, 2000) vs 'Precis of From Metaphysics to Ethics' (article, 2001, PPR). Distinct works.
'From Metaphysics to Ethics' (book, 2000) vs 'Precis of From Metaphysics to Ethics' (article, 2001, PPR). Distinct works.
'Closing statement: linguistics and poetics' vs 'Linguistics and poetics', Jakobson 1960 — the same famous 1960 essay (pp 350-77), b's title is the short form.
a is 'Chapter 10 of The Principles of Psychology' (a single chapter cited as a unit) vs b the whole book 'The Principles of Psychology'; as bibliographic items they are not the same entry.
'The principles of psychology' (Vol I) vs 'The principles of psychology', James 1890. Same foundational work; volume-part vs whole is a trivial variant here.
'Postmodernism' vs 'Postmodernism, or, the cultural logic of late capitalism', Jameson ~1990/1991. Same book, b has full subtitle.
'The Body in the Mind' (b adds subtitle 'The Bodily Basis of Meaning'), Johnson 1987, University of Chicago Press. Same book.
'Unification-based multimodal integration' (1997, EACL, DOI 10.3115/979617.979653) vs 'Unification-based multimodal parsing' (1998, ACL, DOI 10.3115/980845.980949). Different papers, venues, DOIs.
'Unification-based multimodal integration' (1997, EACL) vs 'Unification-based multimodal parsing' (1998, ACL/COLING-ACL). Different papers, venues, DOIs.
